hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean UI chrome with polished controls and a considered warm palette, but the circle-pack visualization is clipped at the bottom of the viewport and the bundled edges form a near-illegible tangle, undermining the core data encoding.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest — scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout node sizing, d3.pack encodes area natively, data-driven domains via d3.extent, and key functions present on data joins; minor issue is the sunburst applies scaleSqrt to the radial (y) axis which compresses outer rings and mildly distorts arc-area proportionality relative to data values.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The circle pack layout with 300 bundled edges crossing arbitrarily through circles creates a spaghetti effect — edge routing follows the hierarchy root rather than the spatial layout, making connections nearly unreadable in this mode; radial layouts would fare better, but the color palette (Tableau10, ~5 visible hues) and single-view structure keep it from scoring lower.
